correctness.rationale: A direct companion-matrix computation gives C^28=I+8E and a convergent interpolation. Three shifted negative-index zeros yield exact 3+ν₂(m+1) laws. The zero-residue quotient has one odd linear coefficient and a remainder contracting by at least 2^3, so it is an isometry with unique 2-adic zero. Its valuation formula and counting of congruence classes prove all indices and density with absolute discrepancy at most 16. The standalone executable checks 200000 terms using a separate integer recurrence; finite checks are not used for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The published complete 3-adic Narayana law poses a natural local-arithmetic counterpart at 2. The solution is a complete nontrivial partition of all indices involving an exceptional 2-adic zero and three shifted zeros. It determines every valuation frequency with a uniform O(1) discrepancy stronger than density alone; the exact invariant is naturally motivated rather than a discretionary finite slice.
